newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat stock firms on car registration data.
newsitem.headline: Fiat stock firms on car registration data.

text.p: Fiat was one of the best performing blue chip stocks on a strong Milan bourse after better than expected Italian new car registrations for December and 1996.

Transport Ministry figures showed Fiat group marques posted a 20 percent rise in new car registrations in December while overall new registrations rose 12.14 percent on December 1995 to 111,000 units against forecasts of 102,000 to 105,000.
At 1042 GMT, Fiat shares were up 4.63 percent at 4,635 lire after a high at 4,675 in volume of over six million shares.
The Mib30 blue chip index was up 1.96 percent.
